spec.name: Reversal v16
spec.notes: High turnover by design: the reversal edge is measured net of 10 bps per unit of turnover.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.5, annual return 13%, maximum drawdown 4%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy exhibits high turnover and relies on a simple reversal signal. While the reported performance metrics are attractive, the research log indicates an extremely small sample size of only three trials, suggesting a high risk of overfitting or insufficient robustness testing. Without further evidence of out-of-sample performance or rigorous stress testing, deploying real capital is premature. The strategy must undergo a paper trading phase to validate the impact of transaction costs and execution slippage in a live environment before any capital allocation is considered.
